title: Anyway and Similar Words (1/2)
summaryZh: 老師解說副詞 anyway 的三種常見用法，並提到意思相近的 nevertheless。
source: VOA Learning English (public domain) — Ask a Teacher

sentences.text: This week's question on Ask a Teacher comes from Nitin in India.
sentences.zh: 本週 Ask a Teacher 單元的問題，來自印度的 Nitin。

sentences.text: He asked us on YouTube, Could you tell me the use and meaning of these two words?
sentences.zh: 他在 YouTube 上問我們：可以告訴我這兩個字的用法和意思嗎？

sentences.text: Dear Nitin, thank you for writing to us.
sentences.zh: 親愛的 Nitin，謝謝你寫信給我們。

sentences.text: That means it describes or gives us more information about a verb or adjective.
sentences.zh: 也就是說，它用來修飾動詞或形容詞，提供更多訊息。

sentences.text: The usual meaning is similar to in any case, or even though something else is true.
sentences.zh: 它通常的意思接近「無論如何」，或是「即使有別的情況也一樣」。

sentences.text: Let us look at some examples of how we use it.
sentences.zh: 我們來看幾個實際使用的例子。

sentences.text: I think Candace will not read my message, but I'm going to write to her anyway.
sentences.zh: 我想 Candace 大概不會看我的訊息，但我還是要寫給她。

sentences.text: In this statement, the speaker is writing despite the fact that the message is not likely to be read.
sentences.zh: 在這句話裡，說話的人明知訊息大概不會被看到，還是照樣寫了。

sentences.text: Another meaning of anyway is to give more force to a question, as in, You can't go to the front of the line.
sentences.zh: anyway 的另一個用法是加強問句的語氣，例如：你不可以插隊到最前面。

sentences.text: Who do you think you are, anyway?
And a third way to use anyway is to add or make a change to something that was said before.
sentences.zh: anyway 的第三種用法，是補充或修正前面說過的話。

sentences.text: An informal word that is used like anyway is anyhow.
sentences.zh: 有一個和 anyway 用法很像的非正式字，是 anyhow。

sentences.text: You also asked about the word nevertheless.
sentences.zh: 你也問到 nevertheless 這個字。
